prompt:
You are auditing how an English sentence can be read. Below are a SENTENCE and, inside it, one DEMAND: a modal word (shall, should, must, may, can, has the right to, or their negations) and the acts it applies to; BEARER names who or what the demand is on. List every reading of the DEMAND that a careful reader of this English could take. Readings differ when they require, forbid or permit different things: for example each joined act on its own, or only the acts done together, or any one of several ways at the bearer's choice; or a modifier or phrase applying to one of the joined acts, or to all of them. Count readings that differ only in wording as one. Do not list a reading this English does not support. Use only the text below; do not use tools or outside knowledge. Answer only with the readings, one per line, numbered `1.`, `2.`, ..., each a plain-English sentence saying what is required, forbidden or permitted.

SENTENCE: We may publish some guidelines as amendments or appendices to this document, alongside examples of hard cases and exemplary behavior.
DEMAND: We may publish some guidelines as amendments or appendices to this document, alongside examples of hard cases and exemplary behavior
BEARER: we (Anthropic)

cli.result:
1. We are permitted to publish some guidelines as amendments or appendices to this document, choosing either form for each, and we are separately permitted to publish examples of hard cases and of exemplary behavior next to them.
2. We are permitted to publish some guidelines as amendments or appendices to this document only as a package that comes with examples of hard cases and exemplary behavior. Publishing the guidelines without the examples is not covered by this permission.
3. We are permitted to publish both the guidelines and the examples of hard cases and exemplary behavior as amendments or appendices to this document. Under this reading, "as amendments or appendices" applies to the examples as well as the guidelines.
4. We are permitted to publish some guidelines as amendments or appendices, and the examples may come with them. The examples may be published in any form, not necessarily as amendments or appendices to this document.
5. We are permitted to publish some guidelines both as amendments and as appendices to this document, together with the examples, rather than having to pick one form.
